groups.name: Write Path
groups.label: Write Path: WAL, Skiplist, Value Log

nodes.label: DB.NewTransaction
nodes.desc: Starts a pending transaction and grabs a read timestamp (readTs) from the oracle.

nodes.label: oracle struct
nodes.desc: Central SSI authority: hands out readTs, assigns commitTs, and remembers recently committed keys.

nodes.label: oracle.newCommitTs
nodes.desc: Assigns the commit timestamp and the next readTs after a transaction passes conflict checks.

nodes.label: oracle.hasConflict
nodes.desc: Compares a transaction's read keys against keys committed since its readTs to reject conflicts.

nodes.label: Txn.commitAndSend
nodes.desc: Serializes conflict detection, stamps entries with the commit version and hands them to the write path.

nodes.label: DB.batchSet
nodes.desc: Collects entries into a pooled request and enqueues it on the write channel.

nodes.label: DB.doWrites
nodes.desc: Goroutine that pulls requests from writeCh and applies them with throttling.

nodes.label: DB.writeRequests
nodes.desc: Writes each request to the value log and the LSM, then applies backpressure when memtables pile up.

nodes.label: valueLog.write
nodes.desc: Appends entries to the head value-log file, rolling to a new file past ValueLogFileSize (~1GB default).

nodes.label: valuePointer struct
nodes.desc: Tiny {fid, offset, len} handle written into the LSM in place of large values (WiscKey separation).

nodes.label: DB.writeToLSM
nodes.desc: Puts every entry (key versioned with KeyWithTs) into the active memtable, storing vptrs for spilled values.

nodes.label: memTable.Put
nodes.desc: Encodes the entry into the WAL, then inserts key+value (or vptr) into the skiplist.

nodes.label: logFile.encodeEntry (WAL)
nodes.desc: Memtable WAL is itself a logFile: length-prefixed, CRC-checked records replayed on startup.

nodes.label: Skiplist.Put
nodes.desc: Lock-free skiplist insert using findSpliceForLevel across tower levels.

nodes.label: Arena.putNode
nodes.desc: Bump-allocator arena: nodes, keys and values live in one big buffer; offsets replace pointers.

nodes.label: DB.flushMemtable
nodes.desc: Serial flush goroutine: takes full memtables from flushChan and streams them into level-0 tables.

nodes.label: memTable.replayFunction
nodes.desc: Replays WAL entries on open so unflushed writes survive crashes.

nodes.label: Builder.Add
nodes.desc: Adds keys with prefix compression; closes blocks when shouldFinishBlock says they are full.

nodes.label: Builder.buildIndex
nodes.desc: Emits a flatbuffer TableIndex: block offsets, max versions, bloom filter length.

nodes.label: OpenTable
nodes.desc: Memory-maps an SST, parses the index and registers block/index caches.

nodes.label: levelsController.addLevel0Table
nodes.desc: Installs a flushed table into L0; signals the flush throttle when L0 is drained.

nodes.label: pickCompactLevels
nodes.desc: Ranks compaction priorities from L0 backlog and level-size overshoot (levelTargets).

nodes.label: subcompact
nodes.desc: Streams one key range of a compactDef through iterators, dropping stale versions and tombstones.

nodes.label: compactBuildTables
nodes.desc: Merges overlapping inputs into new tables with addSplits boundaries.

nodes.label: buildChangeSet
nodes.desc: Produces the ManifestChangeSet describing created and deleted tables.

nodes.label: Manifest
nodes.desc: Append-only journal of the LSM tree layout; ReplayManifestFile rebuilds it at startup.

nodes.label: applyChangeSet
nodes.desc: Validates and applies each ManifestChange, then journals it to disk.

nodes.label: Txn.Get
nodes.desc: Looks up uncommitted pending writes first, then resolves the versioned key against the DB.

nodes.label: DB.get
nodes.desc: Probes all memtables for the key version, then falls through to levelsController.get.

nodes.label: levelsController.get
nodes.desc: Descends levels newest to oldest; each levelHandler.get consults per-table bloom filters.

nodes.label: Table.block
nodes.desc: Fetches (and caches) an SST block, then binary-searches it for the versioned key.

nodes.label: NewMergeIterator
nodes.desc: Heap over memtable and per-level iterators feeding the user-facing Iterator.

nodes.label: Item.yieldItemValue
nodes.desc: Resolves an Item's value: inline bytes, cached value, or a value-log read.

nodes.label: valueLog.Read
nodes.desc: Reads value bytes at a valuePointer from the mmap-backed log file, verifying CRC.
